Grading

  • Feedback by Ms Kim Ward

    Oct 25, 2026 9:20pm

    38 / 40

    Excellent work, a well-earned A grade; your speaking time was 2min 10sec. Your argument was layered and carefully built, and it fully earned the content marks. Your use of rhetorical questions, concrete examples and a measured tone made the speech persuasive. You also spoke with conviction and projected well.

    For future speeches, aim for more eye contact and more variety in pitch and pace. This was one of the strongest speeches in the year level, and it would suit a debating competition. Keep building on this work next year.

    Your allocation of marks was 9, 10, 10 and 9.
